bridge_formula: T(x)=x + k(x,X_train) alpha; alpha=(X_train X_train^T + lambda I)^-1 (Y_train-X_train)
fit_scope: For held-out seed s, train only on matched 4B->1.7B sibling functional-field pairs from the other two seeds. Never use held-out student responses, construction weights, or held-out 1.7B sibling fields for fitting.
probe_leakage_rule: Remove every global probe ID appearing in held-out Active-B32 or Random-B32 selections from bridge training and inner validation, even when that probe occurs in another seed.
lambda_selection: Choose one dimensionless ridge factor by two-fold inner cross-seed validation over the two training seeds; refit on both training seeds using the selected factor.
coefficient_scaling: Use held-out 4B global ancestor norms multiplied by per-domain norm ratios estimated only from bridge-training seed pairs. Residual geometry is invariant to positive column scaling; pi is descriptive only and receives no support/calibration claim.
if_pass: Freeze bridge v1 and run a genuinely new held-out confirmatory cross-scale KD seed before any strong C3 claim or L7.
if_fail: Do not enter L7. Revise the cross-scale functional representation/bridge family and label the revision development-only.
guardrails: Stage5 original cross-scale results remain unchanged and must be reported.
Stage5E/F same-scale sibling experts are calibration/diagnostic surrogates, not genealogical parents.
Stage4 G0 support calibration does not transfer to this bridge.
Construction/exposure weights are never used as bridge targets or functional ground truth.
Passing LOSO Stage5G is development evidence only because the bridge was designed after Stage5; a new seed is required for confirmatory C3 evidence.
